The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 25/11/2023 passed by the learned 2nd Additional Sessions Judge, Nasrullaganj, Distt. Sehore (M.P.) in Spl. S.C. No.74/2022, whereby the appellant stands convicted and sentenced as under:-
 Conviction Sentence

It is submitted that victim is treated to be an adult by the learned trial Court as mentioned in para-12 of the impugned judgment.

As far as consent is concerned, it can be inferred from her conduct inasmuch as when incident took place for first time in the intervening night of 16/05/2022,
she did not complain it to anybody despite the fact that about 10 family members are residing on the first floor of the house and when the incident was repeated on 2 CRA-15390-2023 18/05/2022, then accused had allegedly slapped her, at that time as a reaction she shouted, then family members came and she had narrated her story to her brother-in-law.
sentences._hearing_file: Manoj Uikey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 December, 2025.json

sentences.text: Thus, it is submitted that when victim, herself, states that appellant was known to her and then silence on her part in not narrating the incident despite presence of ten of the family members in the house when the incident took place for the first time on 16/05/2022, reveals her tacit consent.

Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
